title.ko: 부정과 시제: 안 · 못 · 과거 · 미래

sub.en: Negation with 안, 못, -지 않다, past tense (-았/었-), and future tense (-(으)ㄹ 거예요)
sub.ko: 의지 부정(안), 능력 부정(못), 장형 부정(-지 않다), 과거형과 미래형

desc.en: Free printable Korean worksheet on negation and tenses: 안 vs 못 vs -지 않다, past tense suffix -았/었-, and future tense -(으)ㄹ 거예요 with practice exercises and an answer key.

title.en: Negation: 안 vs 못 vs -지 않다

rows: Do not / Is not / Will not (simple or personal choice)
sections.note: Vital distinction: 안 is a simple or willing negation ('I don't / it isn't'); 못 indicates lack of ability or circumstantial impossibility ('I can't'). 못 is never used with adjectives.

title.en: The Three Tenses: Present, Past & Future

rows: Vowel/ㄹ takes -ㄹ 거예요; consonant takes -을 거예요
sections.note: For 하다 verbs: present 해요, past 했어요, future 할 거예요 (e.g., 공부해요 → 공부했어요 → 공부할 거예요).

sections.text: Past indicators: 어제 (yesterday), 지난주 (last week), 작년 (last year), 아까 (earlier). Present indicators: 지금 (now), 오늘 (today), 요즘 (these days). Future indicators: 내일 (tomorrow), 다음 주 (next week), 내년 (next year), 나중에 (later).

title.en: Practice A: Choose between 안 and 못

It is not cold today (adjective): 오늘 날씨가 ___ 추워요 (안 / 못) →
